rv.q: The revue that followed, a satisfyingly silly buddy comedy about the go-nowhere adventures of two “dukes”—a blend of “dudes” and “dykes”—felt like its own live stream of lightning flashes, playful, illuminating, and unpretentiously experimental.
Keeping up successfully with the wild swerves—jokes gleefully masquerading as plot—can make for the heady feeling that you've been initiated into some sort of secret society of loopy logic.

cn.t: Critics praise this lo-fi musical-comedy as a goofball delight that's drawing an unusually young, energetic crowd to SoHo Playhouse with its playful, irreverent take on fandom and obsession.

vr.q: the show is still hilarious... as much as the story is paper thin, it is genuinely a delight to follow the antics of this oddball duo
